title: Basic Tags and Page Structure
description: Learn about essential HTML tags including <html>, <head>, <body>, headings, paragraphs, and comments.

quiz.question: Which tag defines the root element of an HTML document?
quiz.explanation: The `<html>` tag is the root container for the entire HTML document.

quiz.question: Where should the page title be placed?
quiz.explanation: The `<title>` tag is placed within the `<head>` section.

quiz.question: Which tag contains the visible content of a web page?
quiz.explanation: The `<body>` tag holds all the content visible to users.

quiz.question: How many levels of headings are there in HTML?
quiz.explanation: HTML supports six heading levels from `<h1>` to `<h6>`.

quiz.question: Which tag is used for a paragraph?
How do you write a comment in HTML?
quiz.explanation: HTML comments are enclosed between `<!--` and `-->`.

quiz.question:
Can multiple

tags be used in a single HTML document?
quiz.explanation:
Multiple paragraphs can be added using multiple `

` tags.

quiz.question: Which tag is NOT a valid HTML heading tag?
quiz.explanation: HTML only defines headings from `<h1>` to `<h6>`.

quiz.question: Which tag should be used to include metadata such as author, description, or keywords?
quiz.explanation: The `<meta>` tag is used inside `<head>` for metadata.

quiz.question: What happens if the <head> tag is omitted from an HTML document?
options: The browser assumes a default head
The body content will be ignored
The page will display an error
quiz.correctAnswer: The browser assumes a default head
quiz.explanation: Browsers handle missing `<head>` gracefully, but it's best practice to include it.
